isotropic_transformer.name: fnet_fourier_mixer
isotropic_transformer.description: FNet Fourier Mixer Block. Replaces self-attention with an unparameterized two-dimensional DFT over the sequence and channel axes, keeps only the real component, and uses pre-LayerNorm residual branches for both the Fourier mixer and GELU feed-forward network. It is useful when global frequency-domain token/channel mixing is acceptable and a parameter-free mixing path is preferred. The Fourier mixer has no searchable parameters; `ffn_dim` controls only the feed-forward hidden width, and there is no attention mask or causal path.

isotropic_transformer.name: random_synthesizer
isotropic_transformer.description: Random Synthesizer Block. Uses a learned, content-independent token mixing matrix of size `[max_seq_len, max_seq_len]`, sliced to the runtime sequence length, to mix value-projected tokens before projecting back to `global_dim`. The mixer output is added residually with pre-RMSNorm ordering, followed by a ReLU feed-forward branch with the same pre-RMSNorm residual pattern. `num_heads` controls internal projection width through `num_heads * head_dim`, not separate per-head mixing matrices; `ffn_dim` controls the feed-forward hidden width. Inputs are limited to `L <= max_seq_len`, and there is no attention mask, causal path, softmax, or query/key content-dependent attention.

isotropic_transformer.name: relu_attention
isotropic_transformer.description: ReLU Attention Block. Uses standard multi-head QKV projections, but replaces softmax attention with ReLU applied to scaled attention logits, followed by division by sequence length before multiplying values. The attention output is projected back to `global_dim` and added residually with pre-RMSNorm ordering; a ReLU feed-forward branch then uses the same pre-RMSNorm residual pattern. `num_heads` controls internal attention width through `num_heads * head_dim`, and `ffn_dim` controls the feed-forward hidden width. This implementation still computes dense quadratic attention and provides no attention mask or causal path.

isotropic_transformer.name: tslanet_icb_1d
isotropic_transformer.description: TSLANet ICB 1D Block. A pre-LayerNorm residual implementation of the TSLANet Interactive Convolution Block: parallel 1x1 and 3x1 Conv1d branches expand to `ffn_dim`, apply GELU cross-gating, then project back with a final 1x1 Conv1d. It performs local sequence-axis convolution and is useful when short-range temporal or token-neighborhood interactions are preferred over full attention. `ffn_dim` controls the hidden gating width.

isotropic_transformer.name: softs_star_mixer
isotropic_transformer.description: SOFTS STAR Mixer Block. A pre-LayerNorm residual implementation of the SOFTS STAR aggregate-redistribute mixer for BLC tensors `[B, L, C]`, where `B` is batch size, `L` is the variable/series-token axis, and `C` is `global_dim`. Each token along `L` represents one time-series variable after upstream embedding. The mixer projects each normalized token to `core_dim`, applies softmax over `L` independently for each core feature, and sums over `L` to obtain one shared core of shape `[B, 1, core_dim]`; it then broadcasts and concatenates that core back to every token and projects the result to `C` before residual addition. The block uses deterministic softmax-weighted aggregation in both training and evaluation. Its cost is linear in `L` for fixed `C` and `core_dim`; `core_dim` controls the elastic shared-core width.

isotropic_transformer.name: itransformer
isotropic_transformer.description: iTransformer EncoderLayer Block. A pre-LayerNorm residual implementation of an iTransformer-style encoder layer for BLC tensors `[B, L, C]`, where `B` is batch size, `L` is the variable/variate-token axis, and `C` is `global_dim`. Each token along `L` is the embedding of one variable's full input history, so the block expects its input to be arranged in variable-token form. The attention branch performs full multi-head self-attention across `L`: every variable token attends to every variable token, and the block interface cannot exclude selected tokens or token pairs from attention. It forms attention scores of shape `[B, num_heads, L, L]`. The feed-forward branch applies two kernel-1 Conv1d projections independently to each token. `num_heads` selects the elastic head count while the per-head width remains fixed; `ffn_dim` controls the elastic feed-forward hidden width. Attention compute and score-memory scale quadratically with `L`.

isotropic_transformer.name: lion_lit
isotropic_transformer.description: LION-LIT Linear Attention Block. A pre-LayerNorm Transformer-style block using the LION Lit attention path: q/k/v projections are split into heads, q and k are mapped with ELU+1 positive features, attention scores are scaled and normalized by their row sum, then values are mixed and projected back before a GELU MLP residual branch. `num_heads` selects the sampled head count with fixed per-head width, and `ffn_dim` controls the MLP hidden width. Despite the block name, this implementation still materializes pairwise attention scores and provides no causal mask path.

hierarchical_transformer.name: swin_window
hierarchical_transformer.description: Swin Window Block. A 2D-only hierarchical Transformer block whose input and output are BHWC tensors `[B, H, W, C]`; it does not support token-only, class-token, 1D, or 3D samples. It stacks two pre-LayerNorm Swin-style sub-blocks inside one NAS block: regular window self-attention plus GELU MLP, followed by shifted-window self-attention plus GELU MLP. It uses relative position bias, right/bottom padding before window partition, shifted-window masks, and crops back to the original H and W. Use it for image-like feature maps where local attention should scale with window area rather than full spatial size; `num_heads` controls both attention paths and `ffn_dim` controls both MLP hidden widths.

hierarchical_transformer.name: poolformer
hierarchical_transformer.description: PoolFormer / MetaFormer Block. A 2D-only hierarchical block whose input and output are BHWC tensors `[B, H, W, C]`; it does not support token-only, class-token, 1D, or 3D samples. It applies pre-normalized PoolFormer token mixing with GroupNorm(1, C) through an NCHW adapter, fixed 3x3 AvgPool2d mixing as `avg_pool(x) - x`, then a GELU MLP residual branch. It is useful for lightweight local spatial mixing on image-like feature maps when attention is unnecessary. The pooling mixer has no learned spatial parameters, `pool_size` is fixed rather than searchable, and `ffn_dim` controls the sampled MLP hidden width.

hierarchical_transformer.name: uniformer_local
hierarchical_transformer.description: UniFormer Local Block. A 2D-only hierarchical block whose input and output are BHWC tensors `[B, H, W, C]`; it does not support token-only, class-token, 1D, or 3D samples. Inspired by UniFormer's local CBlock, it applies depthwise positional encoding on `global_dim`, then a pre-LayerNorm local spatial mixer with pointwise projection to `mixer_dim`, depthwise Conv2d over the H/W grid, GroupNorm, and pointwise projection back to `global_dim`, followed by a pre-LayerNorm GELU MLP. It is suited to image-like feature maps needing convolutional local mixing with elastic internal width and kernel size. It is not the official NCHW BatchNorm2d CBlock; `mixer_dim`, `ffn_dim`, and odd `kernel_size` values control the sampled mixer width, MLP hidden width, and local convolution kernel.

hierarchical_transformer.name: asmlp_axial_shift
hierarchical_transformer.description: AS-MLP Axial Shift Block. A 2D-only hierarchical vision block whose input and output are BHWC tensors `[B, H, W, C]`; it does not support token-only, class-token, 1D, or 3D samples. It replaces attention with an AS-MLP-style axial-shift mixer implemented by 1x1 Conv2d projection, GroupNorm(1, C), separate horizontal and vertical channel-chunk shift branches, branch addition, GroupNorm(1, C), and a final 1x1 Conv2d projection, followed by an elastic Linear/GELU channel MLP. Use it for image feature maps where low-cost spatial mixing is preferred over attention. `shift_size` must be positive odd, must not exceed the configured super shift size, and the stage channel count must be at least the shift size.

hierarchical_transformer.name: localvit
hierarchical_transformer.description: LocalViT Block. A 2D-only hierarchical vision block whose input and output are BHWC tensors `[B, H, W, C]`; it does not support token-only, class-token, 1D, or 3D samples. The block applies pre-LayerNorm global multi-head self-attention over flattened `H*W` spatial positions, then applies a pre-LayerNorm LocalViT-style convolutional feed-forward residual branch: 1x1 Conv2d + GroupNorm + h-swish/ReLU6, depthwise Conv2d + GroupNorm + h-swish/ReLU6, and 1x1 Conv2d + GroupNorm. It is suitable for image feature maps that need global attention plus local convolutional bias in the FFN. BatchNorm is replaced with GroupNorm, SE/ECA and class-token split handling are omitted, and attention cost scales quadratically with `H*W`.

cnn.name: res_conv
cnn.description: Res Conv Block. ResNet-v2-style pre-activation elastic residual CNN block. Stride or channel changes are handled first by the shared CNNStageDownsample2d transition (GroupNorm -> Conv2d, no activation, no residual); the residual body then runs at `out_channels` with GroupNorm -> activation -> Conv followed by GroupNorm -> activation -> Conv, and returns identity shortcut + body output with no post-add normalization or activation. Both body convolutions share the sampled `kernel_size`, and `hidden_channels` controls the searchable intermediate width between the two convolutions.

cnn.name: depthwise_separable_conv
cnn.description: Depthwise Separable Conv Block. Elastic depthwise-separable CNN block. Stride or channel changes are handled first by the shared CNNStageDownsample2d transition (GroupNorm -> Conv2d, no activation, no residual); the body then runs at `out_channels` with a grouped depthwise KxK stage, GroupNorm + activation, and a 1x1 pointwise projection with GroupNorm and optional activation. It returns identity shortcut + body output with no post-add normalization or activation. Searches over `kernel_size` and intermediate `expand_channels`; `expand_channels` must be positive, no larger than the super width, and divisible by `out_channels` because the depthwise body uses groups=`out_channels`.

cnn.name: efficientnet
cnn.description: EfficientNet Block. EfficientNet/MBConv-style elastic inverted residual block. Stride or channel changes are handled first by the shared CNNStageDownsample2d transition (GroupNorm -> Conv2d, no activation, no residual); the body then runs at `out_channels` as 1x1 expansion -> GroupNorm -> SiLU, depthwise KxK -> GroupNorm -> SiLU, squeeze-excitation, and 1x1 projection -> GroupNorm. It returns identity shortcut + body output with no post-add normalization or activation. Searches over absolute `expand_channels` and `kernel_size`; SE is always enabled and uses squeeze width max(channels / reduction, 8).

cnn.name: mobilenet_v3
cnn.description: MobileNetV3 Block. MobileNetV3-style elastic inverted residual block. Stride or channel changes are handled first by the shared CNNStageDownsample2d transition (GroupNorm -> Conv2d, no activation, no residual); the body then runs at `out_channels` with 1x1 expansion, depthwise KxK, optional SE, and 1x1 projection, using GroupNorm-style normalization and configurable activation defaulting to ReLU rather than the official h-swish schedule. It returns identity shortcut + body output with no post-add normalization or activation. Searches over absolute `expand_channels`, `kernel_size`, and `use_se`. SE uses ReLU, Hardsigmoid gating, and LayerNorm-style normalization.

cnn.name: dilated_conv
cnn.description: Dilated Conv Block. Elastic dilated convolution block for receptive-field search. Stride or channel changes are handled first by the shared CNNStageDownsample2d transition (GroupNorm -> Conv2d, no activation, no residual); the body then runs at `out_channels` as dilated KxK Conv -> GroupNorm -> activation followed by 1x1 projection -> GroupNorm -> activation. It returns identity shortcut + body output with no post-add normalization or activation. Searches over `kernel_size`, `dilation`, and intermediate `expand_channels`; dilation changes share the same sampled convolution weights and only alter spacing/padding.

cnn.name: aspp
cnn.description: ASPP Block. DeepLab-style Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling block for dense context aggregation. Stride or channel changes are handled first by the shared CNNStageDownsample2d transition (GroupNorm -> Conv2d, no activation, no residual); the ASPP body then runs at `out_channels` with parallel 1x1 convolution, fixed-rate 3x3 dilated convolution branches, and a global-average-pooling 1x1 branch concatenated and fused through a final 1x1 projection. It returns identity shortcut + body output with no post-add normalization or activation. Branch width is elastic via `branch_channels`; dilation rates and number of branches are fixed at construction. Uses GroupNorm on convolution branches, LayerNorm2d on the pooled branch, and GroupNorm after fusion; no projection dropout or separable-ASPP path is implemented.

cnn.name: gabor_depthwise_conv
cnn.description: Gabor Depthwise Conv Block. Signal-processing CNN block. Stride or channel changes are handled first by the shared CNNStageDownsample2d transition (GroupNorm -> Conv2d, no activation, no residual); the body then runs at `out_channels`, normalizes with GroupNorm, applies a learnable analytic real-valued Gabor depthwise filter bank, and uses a 1x1 pointwise projection, GroupNorm, and activation. It returns identity shortcut + body output with no post-add normalization or activation. It is useful for texture-, orientation-, and frequency-sensitive feature maps. Elastic over odd `kernel_size` and `expand_channels`; `expand_channels` must be divisible by `out_channels` because the depthwise filter bank repeats per-stage-channel filters. Exported active subnets materialize dense depthwise kernels instead of retaining analytic parameters.

cnn.name: log_depthwise_conv
cnn.description: LoG Depthwise Conv Block. Laplacian-of-Gaussian detail/edge-enhancement CNN block. Stride or channel changes are handled first by the shared CNNStageDownsample2d transition (GroupNorm -> Conv2d, no activation, no residual); the body then runs at `out_channels`, normalizes with GroupNorm, applies a learnable per-filter LoG depthwise filter, adds the LoG response back to a repeated stage-input base when needed, and projects with a 1x1 convolution followed by GroupNorm and activation. It returns identity shortcut + body output with no post-add normalization or activation. Elastic over odd `kernel_size` and `expand_channels`; `expand_channels` must be divisible by `out_channels`.

cnn.name: spectral_conv2d_fno
cnn.description: Spectral Conv2D FNO Block. Fourier Neural Operator-style CNN block. Stride or channel changes are handled first by the shared CNNStageDownsample2d transition (GroupNorm -> Conv2d, no activation, no residual); the body then runs at `out_channels`, lifts channels with a 1x1 projection, applies GroupNorm, mixes low-frequency 2D spatial modes with learnable complex spectral weights using an explicit real DFT-basis implementation, adds a local 1x1 path in the spectral channel space, and projects back with 1x1 convolution, GroupNorm, and activation. It returns identity shortcut + body output with no post-add normalization or activation. Elastic over `modes` and internal `spectral_channels`; active modes are clipped by runtime spatial size and rFFT width. The explicit DFT basis can be expensive on large feature maps.
